PROPOSAL DESCRIPTION: This submittal is for a proposed AWOS III P/T System at CHT.  The current system will be decommissioned and removed and the new system will be located at the new location depicted in this study.  A FAA-funded AWOS siting study determined this location as the 1 000-foot critical area aligns with the previously purchased avigation easement.  Although this proposed location is outside of the FAA’s preferred AWOS siting criteria  this area is outside of any future development at the airport.  It is the intention of the project to remove the identified vegetation (trees & brush) to comply with the critical area requirements and the City will have the full authority to maintain this area free and clear throughout the AWOS lifespan.  It is our intention to include obstruction lights and mark the AWOS with obstruction color and pattern painting unless informed otherwise through a determination. This submittal is only intended to identify and clear an area for the AWOS to be designed and constructed in. A secondary submittal will follow when design has been finalized and equipment details such as frequency and power output are identified.
LOCATION DESCRIPTION: This AWOS-III P/T is proposed to be located in an area north of the Runway 2-20 and 14-32 intersection  offset 526 feet from the Runway 14-32 centerline and 550 feet from the runway 2-20 centerline  between the two runways.
